text: Which of the following is TRUE about the interval I as a HIT?
choices: I is contractible and can be used to prove funext in Book HoTT
I is the same as the circle S¹
explanation: I = {0,1 : I, seg : 0=1}. It is contractible and gives a proof of funext: a homotopy I → (A→B) is an extensional equality.
